The team note is wrong. Reversing the string character by character turns "2026-01-02" into "20-10-6202", which is not "02-01-2026". The year would also come out backwards. The split-and-reorder approach from my earlier answer is still correct.

```python
def change_date_format(dt):
    y, m, d = dt.split("-")
    return f"{d}-{m}-{y}"
```
